title: Finding Dataset Shortcuts with Grammar Induction

bias_targets.methodology: Using probabilistic context-free grammars (PCFGs) and synchronous context-free grammars (SCFGs) to identify syntactic and lexical patterns (e.g., lexical overlap, specific antonym substitutions, hypothesis-only artifacts) that spuriously correlate with class labels, and evaluating model reliance on these shortcuts via counter-examples and rule-based contrast sets.
